title.narrative: Fiscal and Public Investment Expenditure Strengthening Program for Municipalities: Strategies for Rapid Socio-Urban Integration of Migrants in Colombian Cities

description.narrative: The objective of the IDB loan operation is to improve fiscal and urban sustainability in five metropolitan areas through investments in institutional strengthening and infrastructure. A complementary EU-LAIF grant would enhance this objective by strengthening the capacity of Colombian metropolitan areas that are receiving Venezuelan migrants to integrate newcomers effectively.
